---
title: "NAIA Womens Wrestling Championships"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(reactable)

# Read the match data
matches <- read_csv("data/trackwrestling_matches.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Combine wins and losses so each wrestler has their full match log
wrestler_matches <- bind_rows(
  matches |> transmute(weight_class, wrestler = winner, school = winner_school, result = "Won", opponent = paste0(loser, " (", loser_school, ")"), round, score),
  matches |> transmute(weight_class, wrestler = loser, school = loser_school, result = "Lost", opponent = paste0(winner, " (", winner_school, ")"), round, score)
)
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## 103 lbs

```{r}
#| echo: false

summary_103 <- wrestler_matches |>
  filter(weight_class == 103) |>
  group_by(wrestler, school) |>
  summarize(
    wins = sum(result == "Won"),
    losses = sum(result == "Lost"),
    record = paste0(wins, "-", losses),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(wins), losses) |>
  select(wrestler, school, record)

reactable(
  summary_103,
  searchable = TRUE,
  columns = list(
    wrestler = colDef(name = "Wrestler"),
    school = colDef(name = "School"),
    record = colDef(name = "Record (W-L)")
  ),
  details = \(index) {
    w_name <- summary_103$wrestler[index]
    sub_matches <- wrestler_matches |>
      filter(weight_class == 103, wrestler == w_name) |>
      select(round, opponent, result, score)
    reactable(
      sub_matches,
      outlined = TRUE,
      columns = list(
        round = colDef(name = "Round"),
        opponent = colDef(name = "Opponent"),
        result = colDef(name = "Result"),
        score = colDef(name = "Score")
      )
    )
  }
)
```
